The high scores (0.7153) across both paths indicate a strong, consistent relationship between Selgantolimod and Apolipoprotein E through the Magnesium levulinate intermediate. The evidence suggests that Selgantolimod may modulate Apolipoprotein E via this pathway, potentially influencing lipid metabolism.
